WITH filtered AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, name, parent_deck_id, root_deck_id, content_type, scheduler_type, scheduler_version, scheduler_generation, sibling_position, created_at, updated_at FROM decks WHERE parent_deck_id IS NULL AND delete_batch_id IS NULL ), page AS ( SELECT filtered.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_items FROM filtered ORDER BY sibling_position ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) SELECT id, name, parent_deck_id, root_deck_id, content_type, scheduler_type, scheduler_version, scheduler_generation, sibling_position, created_at, updated_at, total_items FROM page
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, COUNT(filtered.id) FROM filtered WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM page)
ORDER BY sibling_position ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, name, parent_deck_id, root_deck_id, content_type, scheduler_type, scheduler_version, scheduler_generation, sibling_position, created_at, updated_at FROM decks WHERE id = #{deckId} AND delete_batch_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, parent_deck_id, 1 AS depth, ARRAY[id] AS path FROM decks WHERE id = #{deckId} AND delete_batch_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_deck_id, ancestors.depth + 1, ancestors.path || parent.id FROM decks parent INNER JOIN ancestors ON parent.id = ancestors.parent_deck_id WHERE parent.delete_batch_id IS NULL AND ancestors.depth < 11 AND NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestors.path) ) SELECT MAX(depth) FROM ancestors
